name: JevGPT
description: Research agent from the paper "JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research" (arXiv 2610.18272): GPT-5.5 plans searches; in BrowseComp-Plus QA, Jev answers parallel Choice (which source lines hold the answer) and Noul (does the region address it) questions per document region and query; includes reproduction code.
